Typo + others

On the main page you have your link to go to the quests category wrong. It's a simple mistake but I can not fix it myself

Also I added your quests and npc's to quests and npc categories. Their are two quests I subcategorized as dew valley but may be better discribed as Townston as that is where your destination is. However I was just doing a fast update to the pages so I put them as dew valley. I can change them over to Townston if that is what you prefer.

Also for npc category, should they be subcategorized as to the area you find them in? Its not that important as long as a the area is stated within the article, I don't think anyone really wonders what npcs are in Dew Valley, more of where is this npc? Which can be easily found by looking it up by name.

And before I forget I put Utility Items as a subcategory to items themselves.

Linspatz CraigH 01:20, 24 July 2007 (CEST)

Re Type + Others

I have altered some of the stuff you have done. For the quests section don't bother about it at the moment, Current Structure for the Quests Page is going to be: Quests by Area, Quests by NPC and Quests by Name.

As for what area they should be in it will be the dungeon they take place in or for ones not in a dungeon where the initial contact is.

The Utility Items I may change back as there is not much there. and I dont think there needs to be a category for 4 sections of one page.

NCSoft Dead and Gone?

Well Ive tried 3 diffrent NCSoft Games repeatedly throughout the day, as well as theyre webpages and nothing but DNS Errror msg. So is NCSoft dead and gone or what? I Seen a message on the News Portion of the NCLauncher that they were planning to shut the NCSoft site down for their maintenance, as they do from time to time, but it was supposed to be a 2hr thing not a all day one. Your the person in the know LR whats up?

Its all okay mate, theres a thread going on on Bugs and Technical issues in the forum, the Network Engeneering team is busy with it too, they were supposed to fix it by now, let me check. And by the way.. a company that works into the millions wont quit from one to another minute, thats simply impossible. --LegendRunner 13:12, 11 January 2008 (CET)

Thanks LR, I was just at the DR Forums and noticed ppl had posted there at times after I had tried to visit the site as well as log into the NCSoft games. It might have been a networking problem out here with some fool of an equipment operator cutting thru a fiber optic cable. Theres no telling. Thanks again
